matches.tactical_summary: England secured third place in a high-scoring encounter, demonstrating superior attacking efficiency. France's defensive vulnerabilities were exploited, leading to a challenging match for their backline.

narrative: The third-place playoff delivered an unexpected goal-fest, with both European giants showcasing their offensive prowess. England ultimately prevailed in a thrilling contest, securing a podium finish.
playoff_notes: The third-place playoff, often seen as a consolation match, still offered players a chance to end their World Cup campaign on a high note. For both France and England, it was an opportunity to restore pride after their semi-final exits.
title: France 4-6 England
